title: Full derived affine sheafification on the localized open site
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an affine open, and $R=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$. Choose derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] of $R$-modules and of sheaf modules on the localized site over $U$. For the explicit affine sheafification functor $F_U$ of [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model], there is a full functor $G:D(R)\to D(\mathcal O_U)$ and a natural isomorphism $G\circ Q\cong Q\circ F_U^{\bullet}$.

source.place: Tag 06Z0, Lemma 36.3.5, affine equivalence followed by localized-site transport

proof.text: Choose the standard derived category for sheaf modules on Spec R. Apply the core affine derived equivalence to R, obtaining its termwise tilde factorization. Compose the equivalence functor with the full quasi-coherent subcategory inclusion.

Compose this functor with the derived affine-site transport equivalence. Both equivalences and the full subcategory inclusion are full, so the composite is full. Whisker the core factorization with transport and compose its comparison using the functor associator.

theorem affine_localized_derived_sheafification (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wR} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U)))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] :
    ∃ G : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ⥤
        DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)),
      G.Full ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ G ≅
        (affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Q)
